local_context.value: On the Lake Wales Ridge between Lake Clinch and Lake Reedy, elevation 82 ft; the name comes from the 1894-95 freeze that destroyed citrus; city since 1960. A real-estate page flags flood and drainage exposure near Lake Clinch (not official).

neighborhoods.value: PARTIAL, listing-site sources only (not official): Clinchwood, North Reedy Shore, Lake Reedy Hills, Lake Reedy Cove, Lake Side Terrace, Oakridge Estates.

place_entities.value: 1) Historic Ramon Theater (1925). 2) Historic Atlantic Coast Line depot (1912). 3) Lake Clinch. 4) Lake Reedy. Also Frostproof Middle-Senior High School.

permit_office.value: City of Frostproof Building Department, main (863) 635-7850; building line 635-7854 or 635-7855 (sources disagree). Contractors must register. https://cityoffrostproof.com/departments/building/
